scope: Optional numeric image-to-semantic calibration for frozen v6 prior; existing train images only
method: Centered train-only ridge alpha1 mapping normalized image vectors to normalized mean training-text vector for the matching training-supported scene
inference: Linear numeric projection plus L2 normalization; no category classifier, labels, text strings, prototype retrieval or tokenizer loaded
coverage: Train only overlapping image/corpus categories; report exclusions, evaluate only prespecified development categories with support
acceptance: No fresh-test access; human listening and later shuffled/fresh grounding required
